modules.name: dart-ffi-facade
modules.purpose: Expose the CI-generated libgit2 ABI, checked lifecycle/error diagnostics, and handwritten conversion and validation helpers through one Dart package API.

business_rules.description: SHA-1 text must contain only hexadecimal characters and stay within the generated libgit2 prefix/full-hash limits.
The local reference-name predicate rejects its handwritten invalid-character, suffix, double-dot, and dot-slash cases; it does not invoke the native validator.
The object-type predicate accepts every integer at or above GIT_OBJECT_COMMIT.value rather than checking explicit enum membership.
A null Pointer<Char> converts to an empty Dart string; otherwise the optional byte length is forwarded to package:ffi.
Only a non-null git_error_last result can create a public LibGit2Error wrapper; the native pointer remains borrowed.
Lifecycle exception diagnostics always include the operation and omit nullable result, owner, and cause fields when absent.

modules.name: native-loader-lifecycle
modules.purpose: Load the platform libgit2 artifact and manage one checked isolate-local native lease with transient calls, persistent owners, rollback, finalizer diagnostics, and guarded shutdown.

business_rules.description: A native lease is committed only when initialization returns a positive result without throwing; all other results attempt one rollback.
Failed rollback or shutdown faults the isolate-local runtime terminally; successful shutdown is cached, idempotent, and prevents re-entry.
Transient calls decrement their pin in finally, and shutdown is rejected while any transient or persistent pin remains.
Persistent owner completion decrements its pin only after successful destruction or explicit ownership transfer; cleanup failure retains the pin.
iOS resolves symbols from the process image; Android has no package-path fallback; desktop platforms try a bare name before the package path.
Windows loads sorted libcrypto DLLs, then sorted libssl DLLs, then libssh2.dll during package fallback.
GIT2DART_BINARIES_PACKAGE_ROOT takes precedence over package URI and package-config discovery.

algorithms: transient and persistent logical pin accounting
exact-once owner cleanup with transfer/finalizer fallback

modules.name: libgit2-global-options
modules.purpose: Map 33 discriminator-specific Dart methods onto 14 exact-width variadic FFI shapes for libgit2 process-global options and prove selected shapes through native round trips.

functions.name: git_libgit2_opts_cache_*
params: object type, Size/IntPtr values or outputs

functions.name: git_libgit2_opts_get/set_extensions
params: git_strarray output or Pointer<Pointer<Char>> plus len

business_rules.description: Every wrapper forwards a fixed generated option discriminator through the matching variadic tuple and returns native status unchanged.
Unsigned pointer-width option values use ffi.Size/Pointer<ffi.Size>; signed cache-size values use ffi.IntPtr/Pointer<ffi.IntPtr>.
Negative pack maximum object size is rejected before native size_t conversion; other integer/range/nullability constraints are not generally Dart-validated.
The wrapper does not own or dispose caller buffers, C strings, arrays, or libgit2-filled output allocations.
The feature-005 64-bit ABI probe must preserve 0x100000011 through set/get and restore the original global value.
The standalone probe reports non-64-bit hosts as unavailable, but the parent integration file accesses the runtime before checking for a declared package root.

modules.name: android-tls-bootstrap
modules.purpose: Extract the package CA asset through replaceable async operations, cache only completed writes, and return a path for externally owned libgit2 TLS configuration.

business_rules.description: A sequential cache hit requires both _initialized=true and a non-null _certPath; no dependency operation runs on that path.
The helper commits _certPath and _initialized only after the selected certificate writer completes successfully.
Directory, asset, and writer errors emit a bounded stderr message, preserve incomplete state for a first attempt, and are rethrown.
The default loader addresses packages/git2dart_binaries/assets/certs/cacert.pem and the default writer flushes bytes to <temporary>/cacert.pem.
Managed libgit2 initialization and certificate-location application are documented caller obligations; the helper neither enforces ordering nor invokes the native option.
Concurrent first attempts are not serialized because no in-flight Future or mutex is stored.
The intended test-only injection surface remains publicly nameable and is exported by the package barrel.

Feature-005 host tests prove injected sequential success/cache/failure/retry state transitions, not Android default dependency execution, external consumer application, HTTPS, or hosted cross-platform behavior.

modules.name: platform-packaging
modules.purpose: Map CI-generated native artifacts into Flutter platform packages and prove selected expanded desktop/mobile consumption routes without conflating declarations, fixtures, devices, hosted provenance, or publication.

business_rules.description: Every declared Flutter target is an FFI plugin, but platform registration shims do not implement Git operations.
Android release inventory requires libgit2, libssh2, libssl, and libcrypto for each of armeabi-v7a, arm64-v8a, x86, and x86_64.
iOS packages four XCFrameworks and force-loads the libgit2 archive for both device and simulator SDKs.
macOS dylib identity must be @rpath/libgit2.dylib and the exported file must not depend dynamically on libssh2 or OpenSSL.
Linux packages libgit2.so and libssh2.so while compatible OpenSSL shared libraries remain an environment dependency.
Windows bundles libgit2.dll, libssh2.dll, and every root-level versioned OpenSSL DLL matched by CMake globs.
Disposable assembly requires an empty output, a binding outside the checkout, a caller-asserted same-run label, and the platform minimum basename inventory.
A clean consumer must resolve its path dependency exactly to the disposable bundle before a bounded compile/load probe is accepted.
The current hosted disposable consumer route selects Linux only; mobile integration apps depend on the artifact-populated checkout.
Pub 1.12.1, Apple podspec 1.11.2, and Android Gradle 1.0 metadata are not synchronized by a local rule.

algorithms: safe disposable package copy with binding replacement

modules.name: native-build-bindings-generation
modules.purpose: Generate the CI-owned Dart ABI and five-platform native exports from pinned sources through fingerprinted, manifest-validated cache and provenance routes.

business_rules.description: Bindings and native libraries receive the same pinned libgit2 1.9.6 input; native builds also pin libssh2 1.11.1 and OpenSSL 3.0.15.
Generated bindings derive from pinned public/sys headers with experimental SHA-256 enabled and are uploaded rather than retained in the current checkout.
A cache is reusable only after exact manifest metadata, safe relative paths, complete file set, SHA-256, and size validation.
Source-build and approved-exception provenance require mutually exclusive source_ref and exception_id fields.
New native exports check git_libgit2_init and git_repository_open; cache-hit semantic execution varies by platform.
Bindings cache keys hash the generator action, manifest script, ffigen configuration, and pubspec lockfile.
Android API level and iOS deployment/OpenSSL target are included in target fingerprints.
The iOS action adds a provenance sidecar to export after manifest creation, making the saved export file set differ from its manifest.
Windows prefix restoration omits the recipe hash while the manifest does not record that hash, allowing older-recipe cache self-validation.
Create-side ValueError handling references undefined root and manifest_path variables, producing a secondary NameError.
Feature-005 local tests prove manifest CLI corruption behavior and parsed configuration facts, not compiler/cache-service execution or same-run artifacts.

modules.name: validation-release-assembly
modules.purpose: Coordinate the 14-job validation DAG, qualify same-run proof/inventory/provenance, assemble a disposable consumer and expanded package, dry-run validation, and event-gated publication.

business_rules.description: The release job waits for five platform-test jobs and the three-ABI Android-other matrix before eligibility.
Every producer uploads diagnostic platform proof; aggregate validation requires eight unique passed scopes.
Proof creation records expected native inventory, hashes, size, observed versions, linkage, and optional Apple attestation.
Aggregate validation does not enforce candidate identity, inventory completeness, linkage/version/attestation semantics, or file hashes against release payload.
Same-run proof origin depends on current-run artifact download semantics rather than record candidate validation.
Release inventory requires bindings, desktop libraries, four libraries for every Android ABI, and four iOS XCFramework metadata files.
OpenSSL provenance must report native-v2, configured version, non-empty files, and all five platform names before eligibility.
Approved OpenSSL exceptions require checked-in exact-parity records with evidence, approver, and an unexpired review date.
The explicit expanded-payload sum must not exceed 256 MiB before the pub dry run.
The disposable release consumer injects the downloaded binding and Linux payload, then compiles public API and loads native libgit2.
BundleEvidence is caller-labelled and runCleanConsumer requires only file presence, not proof JSON validity or payload identity.
Package validation remains reachable for accepted PR/branch-push events, but publication is exact main-branch push only.
Pull requests upload release-package for seven days; main pushes invoke a third-party publisher with pub.dev secrets and skipTests.
Feature-005 local tests prove parser/CLI/fixture semantics, not GitHub service execution, current cross-platform artifacts, or credentialed publication.

algorithms: PR artifact versus main-push publication routing

modules.name: behavior-proving-tests
modules.purpose: Provide the W001-W006 observable-behavior evidence ladder across deterministic state machines, bounded probes, artifact CLIs, disposable consumers, analyzer AST facts, and parsed workflow policy.

fields.name: tier
fields.type: source | parsed | injected | fixture-native | hosted | publication

business_rules.description: W001 accepts native ABI success only when a 64-bit process observes 0x100000011 exactly after the FFI round trip.
An unavailable ABI prerequisite is explicit but can leave the enclosing test green; it is not equivalent to behavior success.
W002 loader failure and Android plan use bounded fresh processes to avoid cached dynamic-library state.
Positive loader probes report the supplied package root but not the actual loaded-library path or successful fallback stage.
W003 caches Android TLS state only after a completed injected write and retries after directory, asset, or write failure.
W004 CLI fixtures require non-zero outcomes for independent corruption families and sanitize the disposable fixture root.
The platform aggregate test accepts hand-written passed records with empty inventory and versions and null attestation.
W005 verifies exact package-config bundle resolution but uses a caller-supplied same-run label and does not observe native handle origin.
The current Windows consumer fixture is cached published package 1.12.1, not a current workflow artifact.
W006 requires resolved analyzer 8.2.0 and parsed workflow facts; both remain local structural models rather than hosted execution.
The architecture visitor matches syntax names rather than resolved element identity and does not inspect parser diagnostics.
Feature-005 replacement inventory removes source-string acceptance for FR-01 through FR-08; unrelated error-constructor source text remains static only.
Fresh safe execution passed 39 cases; the feature execution record reports 67 tests with three environment/platform skips when expanded prerequisites were present.
No local test establishes current same-run hosted artifacts, five-platform runtime, pub.dev publication, or neighboring git2dart behavior.

dependencies: cached published 1.12.1 fixture on local Windows
GitHub Actions for authoritative same-run evidence
algorithms: serialized above-uint32 ABI round trip with restoration
disposable package resolution and native probe modes
exact analyzer resolution and AST fact collection
